name: prgraf
description: See what a change might break: an Obsidian-style blast-radius graph of your working diff, inside VS Code.

prgraf.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that has the prgraf package installed (pip install -e .).

prgraf.projectRoot.description: Project to graph. Leave empty to auto-detect (asks only when the open folder holds several projects). Absolute, or relative to the workspace folder.

prgraf.summary.description: Explain the blast radius in prose using VS Code's built-in language model (GitHub Copilot). The model receives only the computed graph facts — never your diff or file contents.

prgraf.base.description: Default base ref to diff the working tree against.
